rv.q: The casting and staging combine for an intense revival of a modern American classic.

cn.t: Critics hail this intimate production of Wilson's Pulitzer winner as stellar, with powerful performances (especially Bolden's Troy) and electric staging that brings audiences face-to-face with the drama's emotional intensity.
